title: Copilot CLI generated hooks are bash-only and failed silently on Windows with WSL installed

verdict.rationale: The evidence concerns Codex Windows hook wrappers and worktree matching changes, but none of it shows a decision that Copilot CLI hooks should be bash-only or that exact-string worktree matching should stay across WSL/Windows path styles. The Copilot generator simply lacks a powershell key, and nobody chose that behaviour.

fix(strategy): keep BaseCommit updates exact-match only on trailer-less commits

postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly rewrites BaseCommit to the committing
worktree's HEAD, which is only correct for sessions recorded in that
worktree — a sibling session's HEAD didn't move, and rewriting its base
orphans its shadow branch (keyed by BaseCommit + WorktreeID). Route the
no-trailer path through a new exact-match-only lookup so the sibling
fallback never feeds base-commit mutation.

The trailer path keeps the fallback: a fallback trailer only exists
because that session passed PrepareCommitMsg content validation.

fix(strategy): address review findings on identity linking

Critical fixes from the review pass:

- Guest-linked condensation no longer touches the home worktree's shadow
  state. The gate previously guarded only the BaseCommit assignment;
  the shadow-branch delete mark, the remaining-files diff (home shadow
  tree vs the FOREIGN commit tree), and carry-forward (which reads file
  content from the committing — wrong — worktree) all still ran, so a
  guest condensation would rebuild the home worktree's shadow branch
  with the committing worktree's files and then delete it. A guest now
  condenses the transcript, records the trailer state, and returns.

- The "none was linked, run 'entire session adopt'" stderr hint fired
  from inside the worktree matcher, BEFORE the identity union ran — the
  exact scenario this PR exists for printed a false "none was linked"
  (twice: prepare-commit-msg and post-commit) on a commit that got a
  trailer moments later, and also appeared on amend and post-rewrite.
  The matcher now returns an ambiguity flag; the hint lives in the
  commit-linking path and fires only when the FINAL set is empty.
